summary: The app is demo-functional but not launch-ready until auth, secrets, and observability gaps are resolved.

findings.title: Admin action lacks server-side authorization
findings.plain_risk: A user may be able to perform actions they should not be allowed to perform.
findings.next_step: Add server-side permission check and tests.

findings.title: Environment secrets are not clearly separated
findings.plain_risk: Production credentials could be confused with local or test settings.
findings.next_step: Document env requirements and add safe examples.

findings.title: No rollback path documented
findings.plain_risk: A bad deploy may be harder to recover from quickly.

next_approval: Approve Wave 1 fix card for P0-001 after reviewing files touched, verification, and rollback.

learning_priorities.plain_english: The server must check what each user is allowed to do. Hiding a button is not enough.
learning_priorities.plain_other_language: El servidor debe comprobar lo que cada usuario puede hacer. Ocultar un boton no basta.
learning_priorities.why: The app relied too much on UI/client assumptions.
learning_priorities.do_this_next: Pick one protected action and test that a different user cannot perform it.
learning_priorities.success_signal: A cross-user request fails on the server.
learning_priorities.youtube_title: Broken Access Control Explained: OWASP Top 10 A01 Explained with Examples
learning_priorities.video_trust_note: Established application-security educator; verify fit during live generation.

learning_priorities.plain_english: Before launch, know how to undo a bad change.
learning_priorities.plain_other_language: Antes de lanzar, ten claro como deshacer un cambio malo.
learning_priorities.why: The app needs a documented rollback path before launch.
learning_priorities.do_this_next: Write the exact steps to return to the last working version.
learning_priorities.success_signal: A teammate can follow the rollback steps without asking you.
learning_priorities.source_title: GitHub Docs: Managing releases in a repository
learning_priorities.youtube_title: How to automatically generate release notes for your project #Shorts
